create_habitat_env: create a Habitat Env instance with a config and optional dataset to set up simulator and task
reset_env_episode: reset the Env to start a new episode and return initial observations from the environment
step_env_action: step the Env with an action to perform it and return updated observations after the action
create_rl_env: create an RLEnv gym-compatible wrapper around Habitat Env for reinforcement learning with reward and done hooks
step_rl_env: step the RLEnv with an action and return observations, reward, done flag, and info dictionary
